title: Iranian President Pezeshkian Departs for India, Seen Off by First Vice President
text:
Iranian President Pezeshkian Departs for India, Seen Off by First Vice President"

"🔆🔅TEHRAN-SEPTEMBER 11TH — Iranian President Dr. Masoud Pezeshkian departed for India minutes ago, with First Vice President Mohammad Reza Aref seeing him off.
